prompt: A realistic 1970s airbrushed film-poster painting: smooth photographic airbrush gradients, chrome-bright highlights on metal and jewellery, real faces. Camera low at the height of the firebox, fresh banknotes scattered on the stone floor in the foreground. In a hidden 1920s basement print room, a huge cast-iron printing press throws sheets of banknotes into the air. Beside it a tall skinny man in a bowler hat with a heavy gold mayoral chain round his neck, a long narrow face, hollow cheeks and a pencil-thin grey moustache, shovels coal into the press's red-hot firebox, grinning. Behind him an exhausted stoker in a soot-black vest sits slumped against the brick wall. Riveted pipes, brass gauges, steam. A hot pink rim light from behind outlines the figures; the darkness fades from tangerine into ultramarine; one white key from the front left. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
